sentences: Did you know the *first Woody* almost killed *Toy Story*?
In *1993*, Pixar showed Disney an early cut of the movie.
And that Woody was a total *jerk*. Selfish, mean, and yelling at all his friends.
But the Disney bosses *hated* it, and they *shut* the whole movie down.
So Pixar rewrote the story, and turned him into the *kind Woody* we love today.
